dct_description_sm: Contained within the Atlas of Canada's Reference Map Series, 1961 to 2010, is a bilingual map of prince Edward Island. Because of the province's small size, the map can show a great deal of geographical information, such as almost all of: populated places, the township-type entities (usually called ""Lots""), roads, railways, airports, provincial and national parks. The scale also permits contour lines (which are in feet), and the extent of forest cover.. This map is edition 2 of a map that was first produced in 1964.
